feature_name: Enhanced Support Chat with File Uploads
description: Enhance the support chat system to allow users to upload multiple files when creating support tickets, with a two-step submission flow and persistent chat history. Implement a drag-and-drop file uploader with preview capabilities and per-file upload status tracking, while maintaining chat persistence across sessions.
functional_requirements: Build a multi-file uploader component with drag-and-drop functionality that displays file previews and individual upload status indicators
Implement a two-step ticket creation flow where users first request an upload form, then submit the ticket with attachments and details
Add per-user chat persistence that maintains conversation history and a confirmation-based chat clearing mechanism
Create backend endpoints to handle file uploads and return attachment metadata for ticket creation
Enhance the support chat interface to integrate the new upload flow while maintaining existing functionality
